name: Yard terminal-cabinet humidity alarm
summary: Identifies the measured humidity condition used by the selected cabinet supervisory function.
description: Identifies the measured humidity condition used by the selected cabinet supervisory function. Yard equipment supervision carries the condition and support-system information of primary equipment into station alarms. A monitor's declared alarm, measurement and self-fault output need separate point names.

In a switchyard marshalling kiosk, gas compartment, operating mechanism and cabinet-service indications are collected for the station controller. Their equipment tags identify the actual compartment or mechanism being monitored. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Cabinet humidity” at the input and “Cabinet humidity alarm” at the output. The sensor covers a defined local environment.
